name: Reductus Saboteur

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Clandestine
bonuses.text: This Threat gains doubled Defence and Stealth bonuses from cover and visual conditions.

bonuses.name: Extra Arm
bonuses.text: This Threat has 3 arms. If this Threat is wielding a one-handed weapon in each hand, or a one-handed weapon in one hand and a two-handed weapon in its other two hands, it can make one attack with each weapon without suffering a Multi-Attack DN penalty. If this Threat is wielding a weapon with all 3 hands, they can take the Brace Action (Wrath & Glory, page 189) as a free action.

bonuses.name: Passes For Human
bonuses.text: A DN 3 Awareness (Int) Test is required to notice a Saboteur is not Human.

abilities.name: Grenade!
abilities.text: During the first round of combat the Saboteur may Seize the Initiative to make an immediate ranged attack with a Blasting Charge, a Demolition Charge, or a Frag Grenade.

abilities.name: Remote Explosives
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Reductus Saboteur may make one Demolition Charge attack up to 60m away as if they had thrown the charge, representing a booby trap they have placed, or a servitor based improvised explosive that has moved into position.

note: No Unquestioning Loyalty reaction printed. 'Frage Grenades' is a print typo kept.
